text.tspan: Servlet stack (Tomcat): emission at request destruction, async participation without re-wiring
correlation id (header | generated), echo on response
traceId/spanId from the bridge's MDC, startNanos
MDC coverage: the chain, the MVC Callable/WebAsyncTask worker
(EndpointMdcCallableInterceptor), the async re-dispatch and the emission.
NOT covered: DeferredResult producers, raw startAsync() workers, @Async -
application-owned threads; propagate the MDC there yourself.
finally (fail-open, never masks the chain exception)
WARN breadcrumb on the module logger if the chain threw
close the chain MdcScope (previous values restored)
processing continues on an MVC worker thread
TIMED_OUT absorbing, ERRORED only from NONE
throwable (if any) kept as the cause
doFilterInternal runs AGAIN on the EXISTING
ERROR dispatch and after async completion
classification: failure | timeout | 5xx | success; slow escalation
level gate; MdcScope OWNING the trace keys
log() on the exchange logger; events counter
Fail-open everywhere: every host call (MDC adapter, appender, MeterRegistry,
container request/response) is guarded. A failure is counted on
endpoint.logging.failopen (stage = wiring | arrival | emission), reported on the
module's own logger, and never reaches the request. Emission is exactly-once.
